title: Gate performance on physical quality
scope: Add an independent headless benchmark consumer that refuses qualified scores when required quality cases fail.
acceptance: Throughput, memory and median/p95 timings carry a fixed quality-profile hash.
Failed, missing and unsupported quality results block qualified performance output.
evidence: PASS: benchmark gate tests cover qualified output and block failed, missing, unsupported, stale-profile, stale-result and mismatched source/driver/device/toolchain evidence.
PASS: raw 20-sample input produces profile-hashed operations/second, nearest-rank median/p95 timing and public memory peaks; missing quality exits unqualified.
PASS: installed/relocated SDK gate emits byte-identical qualified report to the source-tree tool; SDK install/consumer/conformance checks pass.
PASS: compiled conformance and benchmark gates pass 4/4; 59 conformance tests and 19 roadmap lease tests pass.
LIMITATION: this task defines score admission and publishes no production performance measurement.
